subject: the modal scan after a verified track write, with a tooltip entry (AXHelpTag) listed in Logic's AXWindows
question: With the tooltip under a resting pointer listed in AXWindows and answering AXModal -25205, does create_instrument report the track it created as State A?

reverify.command: With Logic open on a project and a tooltip showing (rest the pointer over a Logic control), list the application's AXWindows and read AXRole and AXModal on each; one entry must be AXRole AXHelpTag with AXModal -25205. Then start the release binary, call logic_system refresh_cache and logic_tracks create_instrument, and read state, reason and observed_delta. Read AXWindows again afterwards; the AXHelpTag entry must still be there. Alternate a build without windowRoleReadsAsHelpTag (State B retry_exhausted, top_level_window_modal_read_failed, -25205) with this one (State A).
reverify.expected: every call creates exactly one track; the build without the change reports State B retry_exhausted and this build reports State A, with the AXHelpTag entry present before and after each call
reverify.cost: needs a running Logic with a project open, a tooltip that stays up, and this shell's Accessibility grant; starts one server per call; creates one track per call

method: Two release binaries were built from one tree: 60fe855d, and the same tree with only AccessibilityChannel+ModalReconcile.swift restored to e42c5453. Against the lpm-locale-campaign fixture in a Korean Logic, each call started one server, sent logic_system refresh_cache and logic_tracks create_instrument, and read AXWindows (role and AXModal of each entry) through the livekit AX runtime before and after the call. The builds were alternated: parent, fix, parent, fix.
conclusion: With the AXHelpTag entry answering AXModal -25205 before and after every call, e42c5453 reported State B retry_exhausted (top_level_window_modal_read_failed, -25205) twice and 60fe855d reported State A twice; every call created exactly one track (20 to 24).
limits: One fixture, one language, one host, two calls per build. The tooltip was the one Logic showed under a pointer left at rest; which control it belonged to was not recorded.
Only create_instrument was driven. The delete path shares topLevelDialogRead and was not driven with a tooltip present.
The sheet scan still visits the tooltip entry; its AXChildren answer was not recorded, only that it did not stop the fixed build's calls.
The Go To Position AppleScript window loops in AccessibilityChannel+Transport.swift were not driven with a tooltip present.

canon_not_applicable.reason: The change rests on an AX role constant (kAXHelpTagRole) and on how Logic's AXWindows answer, measured here; it quotes and depends on no string Logic ships.
